description: List the workspace's webhook endpoints: the URLs where PostFast sends a signed JSON event when a post publishes or fails for good, or when an account connects or disconnects. Oldest first, turned-off ones included. Each has id, url, events, description, active, disabledReason (GONE: its receiver answered 410 Gone; FAILING: its deliveries failed for five days and the workspace owner was emailed; null while it is active, or when a user turned it off), lastSuccessAt and lastFailureAt. The signing secret is never listed: create_webhook_endpoint returns it once. To see what was sent and how the receiver answered, use list_webhook_deliveries.
name: list_webhook_endpoints
title: List Webhook Endpoints
